title: Protocol for evaluating Epigenetic modulation of the renal β-adrenergic-WNK4 pathway in salt-sensitive hypertension
protocol: Randomly assign rats to renal denervation or sham operation every 2 weeks.
Strip visible renal nerves, fat, and connective tissue from renal vessels under a dissecting microscope.
Paint renal vessels with a 20% phenol in PBS solution to destroy any remaining nerves.
Block NE synthesis by administering 300 mg/kg of α-methyl-p-tyrosine methyl ester hydrochloride.
Sacrifice five or six animals from each group at the 6-hour mark.
Remove kidneys for analysis of endogenous NE using SRL, Tokyo, Japan.
Anesthetize each experimental rat lightly with ether.
Insert a cannula into the carotid artery.
Insert a cannula into the jugular vein.
Insert a cannula into the bladder.
Administer physiological saline at 1 ml/hour for three hours through the venous catheter.
Inject HCTZ (2 mg/kg) acutely through the venous catheter.
Collect urine samples every 30 minutes for 3 hours to measure urine volume.
Calculate urinary sodium excretion (UNaV).
Calculate fractional urinary excretion of sodium (FENa).
Monitor mean arterial pressure throughout the process.
Administer metoprolol subcutaneously using an Alzet mini-pump.
Administer ICI118551 subcutaneously using an Alzet mini-pump.
Inject saline acutely instead of HCTZ to measure changes in sodium excretion.
Measure daily dietary sodium intake and urine volume every 24 hours for chronic studies.
Take a blood sample (100 μl) from each rat on the third day of administration.
Estimate percent changes in plasma volume by those in hematocrit.
Anesthetize mice with ether.
Isolate the left carotid artery.
Insert the tip of the catheter in the carotid artery and advance it into the aortic arch.
Position the telemeter body in a subcutaneous pocket on the right flank.
After 7 days of recovery from surgery, continuously monitor mean arterial pressure using a model RPC-1 receiver, APR-1 ambient pressure monitor, and Data Quest ART Silver 4.2 acquisition system.
Set the system to sample mean, systolic, and diastolic arterial pressure over 15 seconds at 15-minute intervals.
Calculate the average values of sampled pressures.
Maintain the recording room at constant temperature and humidity with a 12:12-hr light-dark cycle.
Incubate mouse distal convolute tubule (mDCT) cells in DMEM with 5% FBS and antibiotics at 37°C in a humidified atmosphere of 5% CO₂.
Switch cell cultures to serum-free medium 16 hours before the experiment.
Transfect mDCT cells with WNK4 promoter (-561 +200 bp) TA cloned into PCR2.1 TA vector, then sub-cloned into PGV-B Luc vector using Not I restriction enzyme and T4 ligase.
Obtain WNK4-Luc promoter deletion mutants by using a Kilo-deletion kit according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Stop exonuclease III digestions every 10 seconds during deletion process.
Transform deletions into DH5α competent cells after digestion.
Confirm deletion length with mini-prep kits (Qiagen).
Sub-clone HDAC8 cDNA from mDCT total cDNA into p-CDNA3 expression vector using Hind III and Kpn I restriction enzymes and T4 ligase.
Perform HDAC8 S39A mutation as previously described.
Confirm all ligation and mutation sequences.
Seed mDCT cells in 12-well plates without antibiotics.
Incubate the cells for over 16 hours to reach 80-90% confluence (40-50% for siRNA transfection).
Mix reagent with plasmid or siRNA for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Add the mixture to cells and incubate overnight.
Switch to normal culture medium after 12 hours of transfection.
Incubate cells in normal culture medium for 24-36 hours before experiments.
Fix cells with 1% formaldehyde for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Terminate cross-linking by adding 1.25M glycine.
Harvest and extract nuclei from the cells.
Sonicate nuclear lysates for 40 seconds to generate DNA fragments of 200-300bp.
Use one-third of the lysate as a DNA input control.
Dilute the remaining two-thirds of the lysate five-fold.
Incubate diluted lysate with specific anti-GR, ac-H3, or ac-H4 antibodies at 4°C overnight.
Incubate diluted lysate with IgG antibody as a negative control at 4°C overnight.
Collect immuno-precipitated complexes using protein A/G agarose beads.
Wash the complex four times with low salt buffer.
Wash the complex once with high salt buffer.
Wash the complex once with LiCl buffer.
Wash the complex once with TE buffer.
Treat samples with elution buffer containing 10 mM DTT, 1% SDS, and 0.1 M NaHCO3 for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Perform reverse crosslinking at 65°C overnight.
Extract DNA using the phenol/chloroform method.
Conduct Western blot analysis as previously described.
Subject protein lysates to SDS-PAGE.
Transfer proteins to hybond-PVDF membranes.
Incubate membranes with specific antibodies.
Check equal loading by re-probing the membrane with monoclonal antibody to β-actin.
Quantify blots using Scion Image analysis.
Analyze gene expression quantitatively through real-time RT-PCR as described previously.
Reverse transcribe 5 μg total RNA with Oligo-dT primer using a reverse transcription kit.
Perform real-time RT-PCR on an ABI prism 7300 system, using inventoried primers and probes by ABI.
Conduct immunohistochemistry as described previously.
Measure HDAC activity using the HDAC activity assay kit according to manufacturer's protocol.
Pre-clear nuclear extracts with protein A/G agarose beads.
Incubate pre-cleared extracts with 10 μg of anti-HDAC8 antibody overnight at 4°C.
Add protein A/G agarose beads and incubate for 3 hours at 4°C.
Wash the agarose beads with HDAC assay buffer containing specific components.
Initiate HDAC reactions by adding Boc-Lys(Ac)-AMC substrate.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Add lysine developer and incubate the mixture for another 30 minutes at 37°C.
Measure absorbance at 405 nm.
